description: This file defines the SpotsDashlet class for a SuiteCRM module. It implements a dashboard widget (dashlet) that interacts with 'Spots' beans, allowing display, configuration, and spot management related to the 'Spots' module.

classes.name: SpotsDashlet
classes.description: A dashlet class for displaying and configuring 'Spots' related information in SuiteCRM. Extends the Dashlet base class, manages spot IDs, UI options, and rendering of the dashlet content.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dashlet, loading language strings, setting default options, and calling the parent constructor.

methods.name: checkIfSpotHasBeenDeleted
methods.description: Checks if a spot identified by spotId has been deleted by attempting to retrieve it.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the dashlet's HTML content, including handling the case when the spot has been deleted or not selected.

methods.name: displayScript
methods.description: Intended to output JavaScript for the dashlet, but currently empty.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Displays the configuration form for the dashlet, allowing users to select spots and toggle UI options.

methods.name: getSpotsList
methods.description: Returns a JSON-encoded list of all available spots with their properties for dropdown selection.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Filters and saves user-submitted configuration options for the dashlet.
